cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import importlib.util, json, heapq
from itertools import count
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("m","/workspace/submission/main.py")
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
obj=json.loads(json.dumps({"version":1,"n":5,"capacity":[3,3,3,3,3],
  "edges":[{"u":0,"v":1,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"a"},
           {"u":0,"v":2,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"a"},
           {"u":2,"v":4,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"c"},
           {"u":1,"v":4,"ping_us":6,"ack_us":25,"label":"d"},
           {"u":1,"v":3,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"b"},
           {"u":3,"v":4,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"c"}],
  "rounds":[{"launch_us":0,"timeout_us":30,"host_delay_us":1,"drop_host_ack":False,
             "drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":[]}]}))
n=obj["n"]; edges=obj["edges"]; rounds=obj["rounds"]
eu=[e["u"] for e in edges]; ev=[e["v"] for e in edges]
out=[[] for _ in range(n)]
for i,e in enumerate(edges): out[e["u"]].append(i)
R=len(rounds); dl=[r["launch_us"]+r["timeout_us"] for r in rounds]
ent=[dict() for _ in range(R)]
heap=[]; seq=count()
def push(t,p,rid,key,pl): heapq.heappush(heap,(t,p,rid,key,next(seq),pl))
push(dl[0]+1,1,0,-1,("r",)); push(0,2,0,-1,("p",-1))
ign=0; ded=0
while heap:
    t,p,rid,key,_s,pl=heapq.heappop(heap)
    if p==1:
        print(t,"RELEASE", dict(ent[rid]).keys()); ent[rid].clear(); continue
    if p==2:
        edge=pl[1]
        if t>dl[rid]: print(t,"LATE ping edge",edge); continue
        node=0 if edge<0 else ev[edge]
        st=ent[rid].get(node)
        if st is not None:
            ded+=1; print(t,"DEDUP ping edge",edge,"at node",node,"finalized",st["fin"])
            if edge>=0:
                st["wait"].add(edge)
                if st["fin"]:
                    print(t,"  -> cached ACK on edge",edge,"proof",sorted(st["proof"]),"c",st["comp"])
                    push(t+edges[edge]["ack_us"],3,rid,edge,("a",edge,frozenset(st["proof"]),st["comp"]))
            continue
        if False: pass
        st={"wait":set([edge]) if edge>=0 else set(),"proof":set(),"cred":set(),
            "exp":len(out[node]),"acc":True,"fin":False,"comp":False}
        ent[rid][node]=st
        print(t,"ALLOC node",node,"parent",edge,"exp",st["exp"])
        push(dl[rid],4,rid,node,("t",))
        for eid in out[node]: push(t+edges[eid]["ping_us"],2,rid,eid,("p",eid))
        if not out[node]:
            st["fin"]=True; st["comp"]=True
            print(t,"FINALIZE node",node,"complete=True")
            for e2 in sorted(st["wait"]): push(t+edges[e2]["ack_us"],3,rid,e2,("a",e2,frozenset(st["proof"]),True))
        continue
    if p==3:
        edge=pl[1]; node=eu[edge]; st=ent[rid].get(node)
        if st is None or st["fin"] or edge in st["cred"]:
            ign+=1; print(t,"IGNORED ack edge",edge,"at node",node,"(entry? %s, fin %s)"%(st is not None, st and st["fin"])); continue
        st["cred"].add(edge); st["proof"].add(edge); st["proof"].update(pl[2])
        if not pl[3]: st["acc"]=False
        print(t,"CREDIT edge",edge,"at node",node,"proof",sorted(st["proof"]),"credited",len(st["cred"]),"/",st["exp"])
        if len(st["cred"])==st["exp"]:
            st["fin"]=True; st["comp"]=st["acc"]
            print(t,"FINALIZE node",node,"complete",st["comp"],"proof",sorted(st["proof"]))
            for e2 in sorted(st["wait"]): push(t+edges[e2]["ack_us"],3,rid,e2,("a",e2,frozenset(st["proof"]),st["comp"]))
        continue
    if p==4:
        st=ent[rid].get(key)
        if st is not None and not st["fin"]:
            st["fin"]=True; st["comp"]=False
            print(t,"TIMEOUT-FINALIZE node",key,"proof",sorted(st["proof"]))
            for e2 in sorted(st["wait"]): push(t+edges[e2]["ack_us"],3,rid,e2,("a",e2,frozenset(st["proof"]),False))
        continue
    print(t,"HOST-ACK delivered")
print("dedup",ded,"ignored",ign)
PYEOF
